scope: First adapted melee encounter; source pictures/timings are retained, combat rules below are new sample tuning, not recovered engine behavior.
notes: One successful hit per accepted attack instance; facing and source-ground depth must match.
Enemy cooldown is measured between attack starts. Preview, frame inspection, menus, pause and travel fades suppress combat.
Missing source hurt durations and 10000ms down-pose holds are not used as gameplay timers.
Defeat holds a source down pose; R resets both health pools and the local encounter. Retreat preserves transient health/progress; returning uses the authored enemy spawn for safe arrival.
Hall-only X input buffer accepts one queued basic attack for200ms; Q, air attacks and source pose previews do not auto-chain.
No equipment, rewards, quests, persistence to disk or complete original combat system is implemented.

Ghost Slash uses canonical hardattack18frames/950ms. Its150-450ms hit window,160px range,28px depth and44HP damage are explicit prototype adaptations; SourceSkillRuntime enforces the source6000ms cooldown. No original ACT hit schedule or attack formula is claimed.
